_comment: NeoForge ships this rung already (empty, and wired into all six incorrect_for_<tier> tags), so on this loader ours feeds into theirs rather than standing beside it — a mod asking the ecosystem tag which blocks need netherite gets a true answer. Fabric ships no equivalent, which is why agesandtheart:needs_netherite_tool exists at all and why the six tag files stay in common.
